summary: Per second on the higher of requested and used CPU and memory, at 3× list for sandboxes; there is no stopped state.
lostNote: Modal sandboxes have no stopped state; keeping files needs a Volume or a snapshot.
notes: Modal bills per physical core and documents one core as 2 vCPUs, so a vCPU here is half a core. Battleships prices a whole core as one vCPU, twice this figure. How many CPUs the machine itself reports per core was not tested.
Egress beyond the plan's included amount is $0.04 per GiB and is not included.
